texts.parametrization_space: epsilon, log B_SD, epsilon_nd, logit w_excited, log flavor weights (r_V among them), the log intact vertex factor, f_isovector
texts.report_title: R97: the R96 contract with the intact proton's vertex term, at the R96 optimum with the exponents moved
texts.report_kernel_line: the density-weighted continuation step above the 2.0 GeV floor with the P-wave barrier on the isospin-complete towers (baryonic, strange baryonic, strange mesonic) with the Delta-like lines, the sibling weight at the edge mass (the committed rule, control); the exact 2 -> 2 transfer window, the per-line thresholds, the flat three-body phase space; the model bins converted to the tabulated points (the bin-center correction); the isovector exchange fraction free; diffractive shapes free. The leading-baryon split: a share 0.2 of the baryonic continuum roots draws over the split channels (its established baryon and a mesonic continuum state of mass mu), mu flat in ln mu^2, the baryon along the incoming baryon with exp(4 cos theta); the other roots draw over every continuum channel with the density step and isotropic angles, the split channels included. The factorized vertex slopes: each 2 -> 2 transfer follows exp(B t) at B = b_sd [(m_p/M1)^1.25 + (m_p/M2)^1.25] / 2. The vacuum lines draw their low-mass record over the I = 1/2 records with weight 2J + 1. The isoscalar S-wave dipion: the f0(500) record (pole 475 MeV, width 550 MeV, pi pi at the I = 0 shares), the six N* multiplets at the PDG 2025 hadronic decay modes (range midpoints, isospin Clebsch-Gordan charge splits, normalized), and the (N, f0(500)) class of the baryonic continuum's direct pool. The floor pools: a charged or strange mesonic continuum state with no open continuation channel also decays into the heavier pairs (rho omega, rho rho, f2 pi, a2 pi, a1 pi, b1 pi, rho(1450) pi, phi pi, K* Kbar*; K* rho, K* omega, K eta, phi K, K1(1270) pi, K2*(1430) pi, K f2) with the direct pairs' weight law; the continuation steps keep the committed classes. The single-diffraction classes carry an intact proton on the non-excited line (the nominal R50 split was intact 0.5, low-mass resonance 0.5), as the single-diffraction anchor pp -> pX counts it. The charge-conjugate baryonic towers: the conjugate of every baryonic family, every antibaryon record the conjugate of its baryon, and the two conjugate baryon-pair continuations of a mesonic vertex at half the weight each. The baryon-resonance pairs: the neutral mesonic continuum also pairs N, N*(1440), N(1520) and N(1535) with each other's antibaryons at matched charge, and Delta(1232) with its antibaryon, with the direct pairs' weight law, the baryon-pair share of its continuation channels and of its direct pairs each held at its value without them. The minimum continuation-step momentum: a continuation channel opens only when its sibling's decay momentum at the daughter's floor mass reaches 0.25 GeV/c, and a state whose continuation channels all close decays into its direct pairs. The isospin mixture of the non-diffractive lines: in the non-diffractive events every baryonic continuum vertex counts each charge combination of its continuation channels and direct pairs equally, the equal mixture of I = 1/2 and 3/2; the diffractive lines keep the isospin shares of I = 1/2. The review of 2026-10-10: the flavor ledger of a split-branch root normalizes over the split channels it was drawn over, and every antibaryon decays as the charge conjugate of its baryon. The leading-meson split: at a root of the leading-baryon split a share 0.03 of the decays draws over the continuation channels of an established meson and a baryonic continuum state of mass mu, mu flat in ln mu^2, the meson along the incoming baryon with exp(kappa cos theta), kappa = 2 b q*^2 at b = 4 GeV^-2; the other decays of those roots draw as before. The light scalar mesons: the f0(980) (990 MeV, width 55 MeV, pi pi : K Kbar = 0.68 : 0.32) and the three a0(980) charge states (980 MeV, width 75 MeV, eta pi : K Kbar = 1 : 0.172) as catalog records; the neutral mesonic continuum pairs omega f0, a0 0 pi0 and a0+- pi-+, and the non-strange baryonic continuum pairs the nucleon with the f0(980) beside the f0(500), the first kaon-pair channel of a non-strange baryonic vertex. The (N, Kbar*) pairs: every strange baryonic continuum vertex pairs the nucleon with the Kbar*(892) beside each (N, Kbar) pair, so a hyperon-like line hands its strangeness to a vector antikaon as well. The low-mass non-diffractive lines: a vacuum non-diffractive line below 2.0 GeV decays as one of the low-mass (1, 1, 0) N* and Delta records at its own mass and momentum, each record with weight (2J + 1) times its Breit-Wigner inside its mass range, equal for both isospins; below 1.4 GeV the line also takes its mass from the records' line shapes, the continuum's share below that mass kept. The non-diffractive lines carry no low-mass record kind: every excited non-diffractive remnant is a continuum line (w_excited fixed at 1). The vector-to-pseudoscalar weight r_V of the continuum vertices is free. The intact proton of the single-diffraction classes carries its own vertex term f of the factorized vertex slopes, free.
texts.obligation: the two-component fit with the leading-baryon split, the factorized vertex slopes at the mass exponent 1.25, the isoscalar low-mass remnant and the isoscalar S-wave dipion at the 2.0 GeV continuation floor, with the floor pools of the charged and strange mesonic continuum, the single-diffraction non-excited line intact, the charge-conjugate baryonic towers, the baryon-resonance pairs the minimum continuation-step momentum 0.25 GeV/c, the isospin mixture of the non-diffractive lines the leading-meson split the light scalar mesons f0(980) and a0(980) and the (N, Kbar*(892)) pairs of the strange baryonic lines and the low-mass non-diffractive lines through the N* and Delta records below 2.0 GeV, their line shapes below 1.4 GeV and no low-mass record kind on the non-diffractive lines and the vector-to-pseudoscalar weight r_V free and the intact proton's vertex term f free (R97, generated at the R96 optimum with f 1.3, epsilon 0.5 and epsilon_nd 0.25)
texts.hypothesis: The R96 kernel with the intact proton's own vertex term f free in the factorized vertex slopes of the single-diffraction classes (B = b [f + (m_p/M_X)^1.25] / 2), generated at the R96 optimum with f at 1.3, the single-diffraction exponent at 0.5 and the non-diffractive one at 0.25, describes the six p+p species and the neutron dN/dx_F as measured; the fit reports the parameters and the residual map against R96 (chi2 5,957).

kernel_change.unchanged: every kernel option of R96 (r_V free), R95 (w_excited fixed at 1) and R94: the low-mass non-diffractive lines through the N* and Delta records, the (N, Kbar*(892)) pairs, the light scalar mesons, the leading-meson split, the isospin mixture of the non-diffractive lines, the baryon-resonance pairs, the step minimum 0.25 GeV/c, the charge-conjugate towers, the vertex-slope exponent 1.25, the intact single-diffraction line, the floor pools, the 2.0 GeV continuation floor, the exact transfer window, the per-line thresholds, the three-body phase-space law, the density continuation law with the P-wave barrier, the edge sibling weight, the bin-center correction, the leading-baryon split, the isoscalar low-mass remnant, the isoscalar S-wave dipion, the class fractions at the external anchors
kernel_change.leading_split: at a baryonic continuum root (depth 0) the one channel uniform u picks the branch: for u < 0.2 the draw runs over the split channels (an established baryon and a mesonic continuum daughter) on their weights, the remainder's mu^2 flat in ln mu^2 on [floor^2, edge^2] at the density uniform and the baryon's direction in the root frame from exp(4 cos theta) about the incoming baryon (the sign of the root's c.m. p_z); otherwise the draw runs over every continuum channel with the density step and isotropic angles, the split channels included; the later steps are the committed cascade (2026-10-08; both branches named 2026-10-10)
kernel_change.vertex_slopes: each exact-window transfer of the 2 -> 2 classes is drawn from exp(B t) at B = b_sd [(m_p/M1)^k + (m_p/M2)^k] / 2 with k = 1.25 (0.75 through R87; the topology option transfer_slope_mass_exponent, 2026-10-09), M1 and M2 the outgoing lines' masses (a line at or below m_p counts as m_p); the event records B / b_sd and the reweighting follows it; the class with the central source keeps the single slope (2026-10-08)
kernel_change.isoscalar_remnant: the vacuum lines draw the low-mass record over the I = 1/2 records below the kernel boundary (the proton, N(1440), N(1520), N(1535), N(1650), N(1680), N(1720)) with weight 2J + 1, by the same residual uniform; the Delta+ states stay on the isovector lines (2026-10-08)
kernel_change.isoscalar_dipion: KernelConfig.isoscalar_dipion (na49_mixing.isoscalar_dipion, config/v2_singlet/isoscalar_dipion_pdg2025.json): the f0(500) record (I = 0, J^P = 0+, pole 475 MeV, width 550 MeV, support from the pi0 pi0 threshold to 1.0 GeV, pi+ pi- : pi0 pi0 = 2 : 1 in an S-wave); N(1440), N(1520), N(1535), N(1650), N(1680) and N(1720) at every PDG 2025 hadronic mode whose daughters are catalog records (N pi, N eta, Delta pi, N rho, N sigma, N omega, Lambda K, N(1440) pi, N(1520) pi) at the range midpoints (half an upper limit), split by the isospin Clebsch-Gordan shares and normalized to unity; the (2212, 9000221) class in the baryonic_np direct pool, rotated to the charge partners by the isospin completion (the I = 3/2 families at Clebsch-Gordan weight 0) (2026-10-08)
kernel_change.continuation_floor: every family's continuation floor at 2.0 GeV (1.7 GeV since R74): a continuum state below it decays directly into two established hadrons; the leading-baryon split's remainder follows it (2026-10-09)
kernel_change.floor_pools: KernelConfig.floor_pools ['charged', 'strange'] (na49_mixing.floor_pools): the I = 1 partners of the neutral pool's heavier pairs in the charged and anticharged mesonic families and the heavier strange pairs in the four strange mesonic families join the direct pairs of a vertex with no open continuation channel, with the direct pairs' weight law (2026-10-09)
kernel_change.diffractive_split: the run spec's diffractive_split {intact_proton 1.0, low_mass_baryonic_resonance 0.0, high_mass_baryonic_continuum 0.0} on the single-diffraction non-excited line (the nominal R50 split 0.5/0.5/0.0 before; the anchor sigma_SD = 6.5 mb counts pp -> pX with the recoil proton) (2026-10-09)
